Name: Shroom Spotter
Author: TehPers
Description:
This mod just adds a mushroom icon on days when you'll find mushrooms in the mines. Hovering over that day will list the floors you'll be able to find them on. Also, you can press '5' on your numpad to list the floors you can find mushrooms on. If no mushrooms can be found today, it will look into the future for the next day that will have mushrooms.

[b]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.2+. Also available on [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/moddrop-mod-manager-for-sdv.4544/]ModDrop[/url].[/b]
[b]Beta version for Stardew Valley 1.3+ exists as well.[/b]
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7934]Strobe has updated the mod for SDV 1.5.[/url]﻿
[color=#0000ff]I don't plan on updating this mod anymore. Sorry. Check [url=https://smapi.io/mods/#Shroom_Spotter]the SMAPI mods list[/url]for the latest information on what mods can replace this.[/color][/b]

[size=5]Install[/size]

[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]. (For Stardew Valley 1.3 beta, use the SMAPI beta version)
